maya.activity: Wake up, stretch in bed, and read the news on my phone before getting dressed.
maya.intention: Start the day quietly and ease into the morning.

maya.activity: Make coffee and a quick breakfast, then pack lunch and fill a water bottle for the workday.
maya.intention: Eat something simple and have lunch ready before work begins.

maya.activity: Clear the breakfast things, bring my work laptop to the glass desk, and set up my notebook and pencils for the morning meetings.
maya.intention: Make the desk ready without turning the whole morning into a ceremony.

maya.activity: Work from home at the glass desk, attend planning meetings, and review transportation maps and notes.
maya.intention: Handle the morning planning work and keep clear notes for follow-up.

maya.activity: Take a lunch break, eat the packed lunch, and briefly step away from the desk before the afternoon work block.
maya.intention: Actually pause instead of eating beside a map revision.

maya.activity: Continue remote work at the glass desk, review project material, and write concise project notes.
maya.intention: Finish the afternoon work and leave the notes usable for the next review.

maya.activity: Finish the work block, save my notes, put the laptop in the left desk drawer, and carry the mug and water bottle back to the kitchen.
maya.intention: Create a clean boundary between work and evening.

maya.activity: Change clothes in the closet, put my work clothes away, and make tea to drink while decompressing.
maya.intention: Get out of work clothes and let my brain stop holding meetings.

maya.activity: Practice piano scales and a few difficult passages, using the music kept under the black paperweight.
maya.intention: Practice deliberately but keep it restorative rather than competitive.

maya.activity: Help prepare dinner and eat at the dining table after Daniel's usual improvised cooking start.
maya.intention: Share the evening meal and use up whatever needs attention first.

maya.activity: Clear my plate and help wash and put away the dinner things, then wipe the kitchen counter.
maya.intention: Leave the kitchen reasonably settled before the late evening.

maya.activity: Have quiet free time in the living room, with a mug of tea if I want one, while Daniel plays or listens through headphones.
maya.intention: Let the day taper off without starting another task.

maya.activity: Read fiction in the bedroom and prepare clothes for tomorrow, leaving my worn cardigan on the bedroom sofa if it is still wearable.
maya.intention: Read enough to feel finished with the day and make tomorrow morning easier.

maya.activity: Put my phone on charge, place my reading glasses in the upper nightstand drawer, and get into bed.
maya.intention: Close out the day and be ready for sleep.

daniel.activity: Wake up, brush my teeth, shower, and make coffee while listening to a podcast.
daniel.intention: Get ready calmly and wake up before work.

daniel.activity: Make breakfast and eat at the kitchen counter while talking with Maya.
daniel.intention: Have a quick breakfast and connect before starting work.

daniel.activity: Set up my work laptop, edit dialogue, attend remote production calls, and monitor audio with headphones.
daniel.intention: Complete the morning audio work and keep clear notes from calls.

daniel.activity: Make a quick lunch and eat standing at the kitchen counter, tasting as I go.
daniel.intention: Eat efficiently and reset before the afternoon session.

daniel.activity: Continue editing and monitoring audio from bedroom 2, joining the remote studio session as needed and keeping revision notes in writing.
daniel.intention: Finish the afternoon mix work and save a clean session before dinner.

daniel.activity: Cook an improvised dinner using ingredients that need to be used first, then leave the tasting spoon on the sink side while I finish up.
daniel.intention: Make dinner without overcomplicating it and use up leftovers.

daniel.activity: Eat dinner at the dining table and drink water, helping clear the most visible kitchen items afterward.
daniel.intention: Have dinner with Maya and keep the kitchen usable.

daniel.activity: Play digital piano arrangements and listen critically through my headphones.
daniel.intention: Wind down while checking musical details away from the work session.

daniel.activity: Put away the piano headphones, drink water, and relax on the sectional while checking tomorrow’s work notes.
daniel.intention: Let my ears recover and transition out of work mode.

daniel.activity: Brush my teeth, change into sleepwear, and get into bed.
daniel.intention: Finish the day and get a full night’s sleep.
